asks: Do you know who I belonged to?
Have you still got the other one?
description: The thing in front of you is enormously old and it recognises you. Not your face. Something further back than that, in the way you stand.
emotes: {it} leans a fraction of a degree toward you.
The bad old repair on {it} looks, for a second, freshly done.
{it} warms slightly, the way a thing does when it has been sat against.
looks: The grain runs in a pattern you have seen before and cannot place.
There's a repair on one side, done badly, a long time ago, by somebody in a hurry.
It has been moved a great many times and has never once been thrown away.
name: a piece of furniture that knew your family
says: I was in a different room when I last saw that.
Somebody kept me. That's the whole of it.
